fidelity: F2a — Coupled Hinged-Raft Oscillators with Hydraulic PTO (lumped, frequency-domain hydrodynamics + time-domain ODE)
source: Yemm et al. (2012) Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 370:365-380 (Pelamis P2); Falnes (2002) Ocean Waves and Oscillating Systems, Cambridge UP; Henderson (2006) Appl. Ocean Res. 28:297-307; Newman (1979) Applied Ocean Research 1:189-196 (hinged raft).

unit.name: Generic Pelamis-class attenuator — 5 tubes / 4 PTO joints, semi-submerged cylinders

n_segments.note: Number of rigid floating tube segments (Pelamis P2 = 5 tubes)

n_joints.note: Number of hinge joints with hydraulic PTO rams

L_segment.note: Length of each cylindrical segment (Pelamis P2 ~180m / 5)

rho_body.note: Effective mean structural density of segment (buoyant)

added_mass_coeff.note: Pitch added-inertia coefficient (Newman 1979 hinged raft, O(1))

rad_damp_coeff.note: Dimensionless radiation damping for relative pitch mode

excite_coeff.note: Per-joint capture-width fraction of point-absorber bound (lambda/2pi); ties excitation to radiation damping via Haskind relation. Calibrated so device CWR ~0.2-0.35 (Babarit 2015)

B_pto.note: PTO rotational damping per joint (hydraulic ram + accumulator); near impedance-match optimum for mid sea states

K_pto.note: PTO reactive stiffness per joint (0 = pure damping / resistive control)

theta_max.note: Max relative hinge angle (~30 deg) before end-stops
